public_summary.title: Service observation window
observed_symptoms: Request latency and error rate observation window

decisions.reason: No evidence has been gathered yet. Assigning one metrics task and one changes task to establish baseline service metrics, dependency topology, and change history before proposing any hypotheses.

assignments.question: Retrieve dependency graph and latency/error metrics for gateway, backend, postgres, redis, and payment during 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z to 13:00:00Z to identify which service shows elevated latency/error rate and how services depend on each other.
assignments.reason: No evidence exists yet; a baseline of service metrics and dependency topology is needed to form evidence-based hypotheses.
assignments.expected_discriminator: Latency/error metrics showing which service degrades first or most, plus dependency graph showing call paths between gateway, backend, postgres, redis, payment.

assignments.question: Query recent changes/deployments/config diffs for all services in the observation window to identify any change correlated with the latency/error symptoms.
assignments.reason: No evidence exists yet; change history is a concrete causal source that may explain the observed latency/error window.
assignments.expected_discriminator: A deployment, config, maintenance, or scaling change correlated with the observation window, or a config diff that explains a latency/error change.
